title: Soleilune
description: Soleilune adds custom blocks, armor, and items that have custom effects.
body:
# What is Soleilune?
Soleilune is my first mod in a long time. It is a mod that adds custom blocks, armor, and items into the game. It's name comes from me smashing the French words for sun and moon together!

# Soleilune Features
Soleilune has the following features!
- 3 new armor sets
- 2 of which give an effect when all parts are wared
- 3 new swords
- 2 of which apply an effect on an enemy
- 3 new blocks
- 2 of which do an AOE
- Three ores that make the pervious things possible
- 2 of which explode on steping on them

# Find Any Bugs?
If you find any bugs go to my GitHub Repo: [https://github.com/Vodculen/Soleilune-1.21.1](https://github.com/Vodculen/Soleilune-1.21.1)

# Updates?
Updates will come out every once and a while when I have time.
